title: Liderlik va jamoa boshqaruvi
goal_uz: Dars oxirida vazifani aniq topshirasiz, maqsad va kutilmalarni belgilaysiz, jamoani aniq maqtov bilan rag‘batlantirasiz va bir-biringiz bilan individual uchrashuvni tartibli o‘tkazasiz.

scenes.title: Jamoani yetaklash
board: Leading and motivating a team
Topshirish · maqsad · rag‘bat · one-to-one
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda mojaro va fikr-mulohaza bilan ishladik. Bugun liderlik tilini o‘rganamiz. Lider ko‘p narsani o‘zi qilmaydi: u to‘g‘ri odamga to‘g‘ri vazifani beradi, maqsadni aniq aytadi, yutuqni ko‘ra oladi va har bir xodim bilan alohida suhbatlashadi. Dars oxirida siz vazifani topshirasiz, kutilmalarni belgilaysiz, aniq maqtov aytasiz va yakka uchrashuvni boshqarasiz. Uyga vazifa esa jamoa uchun boshlang‘ich nutq yozish bo‘ladi. Lavozim kuch beradi, lekin jamoani so‘zlar yetaklaydi.
scenes.say: Good to see you again. Last time we handled conflict and feedback. Today we move to leadership. A good leader does not do everything alone. She gives the right task to the right person, makes goals clear, notices good work and talks to each person individually.
scenes.say_uz: Sizni yana ko‘rganimdan xursandman. O‘tgan safar mojaro va fikr-mulohazani ko‘rdik. Bugun liderlikka o‘tamiz. Yaxshi lider hamma narsani yolg‘iz qilmaydi: to‘g‘ri vazifani to‘g‘ri odamga beradi, maqsadni aniq qiladi, yaxshi ishni payqaydi va har bir kishi bilan alohida gaplashadi.

scenes.title: Vazifani topshirish
board: Outcome · Context · Authority · Deadline · Check-in
I would like you to take ownership of…
You have the authority to…
Let’s touch base on Thursday

examples.t: I would like you to take ownership of the supplier onboarding.
examples.uz: Yetkazib beruvchilarni ulash ishini zimmangizga olishingizni xohlayman.

examples.t: You have the authority to approve spending up to two thousand pounds.
examples.uz: Ikki ming funtgacha xarajatni tasdiqlash vakolati sizda.

examples.t: Let’s touch base on Thursday to see where you are.
examples.uz: Ahvolni bilish uchun payshanba kuni gaplashib olamiz.

scenes.say_native: Yaxshi topshiriq beshta narsadan iborat: natija, kontekst, vakolat, muddat va tekshiruv vaqti. Avval natijani ayting: „I would like you to take ownership of the supplier onboarding“. Ownership — bu shunchaki bajarish emas, balki ish uchun javobgarlikni olish. Keyin nima uchun muhimligini tushuntiring, so‘ng vakolat bering: „You have the authority to approve spending up to two thousand pounds“. Oxirida muddat va nazorat vaqtini kelishing: „Let’s touch base on Thursday“. Bu o‘zbekchadagi „mana buni qilib qo‘ying“ dan farq qiladi: inglizcha ish madaniyatida buyruq emas, ishonch va aniqlik kutiladi.
scenes.say: A strong delegation has five parts: the outcome, the context, the authority, the deadline and a check-in. I would like you to take ownership of the supplier onboarding. You have the authority to approve spending up to two thousand pounds. Let's touch base on Thursday to see where you are.
scenes.say_uz: Kuchli topshiriq besh qismdan iborat: natija, kontekst, vakolat, muddat va tekshiruv. Yetkazib beruvchilarni ulash ishini zimmangizga olishingizni xohlayman. Ikki ming funtgacha xarajatni tasdiqlash vakolati sizda. Ahvolni bilish uchun payshanba kuni gaplashamiz.

scenes.title: Xato: tashlab ketish va nazorat
board: ✗ Do this by tomorrow. (kontekstsiz)
✓ Here is why it matters and what good looks like
✗ Send me every draft (micromanage)

examples.t: Here is why this matters to the client, and here is what good looks like.
examples.uz: Bu mijoz uchun nega muhim va yaxshi natija qanday ko‘rinishda ekanini aytaman.

examples.t: How you get there is up to you.
examples.uz: Qanday yetishingiz o‘zingizga bog‘liq.

scenes.say_native: Topshirishda ikkita qarama-qarshi xato bor. Birinchisi — kontekstsiz tashlab ketish: „Do this by tomorrow“. Odam nima uchun va qanday sifatda ekanini bilmaydi. Ikkinchisi — micromanagement, ya’ni har qadamni nazorat qilish: „Send me every draft“. Bu odamni ishonchsizlikdan charchatadi. To‘g‘ri yo‘l o‘rtada: „Here is why this matters, and here is what good looks like. How you get there is up to you.“ Ya’ni natijani aniq qiling, usulni erkin qoldiring. O‘zbek jamoalarida ko‘pincha „o‘zim qilsam tezroq“ degan fikr bor, lekin lider shunday qilsa, jamoa o‘smaydi.
scenes.say: There are two opposite mistakes. One is dumping a task with no context: do this by tomorrow. The other is micromanaging: send me every draft. The balance sounds like this: here is why this matters to the client, and here is what good looks like. How you get there is up to you.
scenes.say_uz: Ikkita qarama-qarshi xato bor. Biri kontekstsiz vazifa tashlab ketish, ikkinchisi har qadamni nazorat qilish. Muvozanat shunday: bu mijoz uchun nega muhimligi va yaxshi natija qanday ekanini ayting, usulni esa o‘ziga qoldiring.

scenes.title: Mashq: vazifa topshiring
board: Task: prepare the quarterly customer survey
Person: Dilnoza, analyst
Deadline: 14th · budget 500 · check-in Monday
scenes.say_native: Dilnoza ismli tahlilchiga choraklik mijozlar so‘rovnomasini tayyorlashni topshiring. Natijani ayting, nima uchun muhimligini tushuntiring, vakolat va byudjetni bering, muddat o‘n to‘rtinchi kun, tekshiruv esa dushanba. Besh qismni ham ishlatishga harakat qiling. Javobingizni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Delegate this task to Dilnoza, an analyst: prepare the quarterly customer survey. State the outcome, explain why it matters, give her authority over a budget of five hundred, set the fourteenth as the deadline and agree a check-in on Monday.
scenes.say_uz: Bu vazifani tahlilchi Dilnozaga topshiring: choraklik mijozlar so‘rovnomasini tayyorlash. Natijani ayting, nega muhimligini tushuntiring, besh yuz byudjet ustidan vakolat bering, muddat o‘n to‘rtinchi kun, tekshiruv dushanba.

scenes.title: Javob: topshiriq namunasi
board: Dilnoza, I’d like you to own the quarterly survey.
It will shape next year’s product plan.
Budget: 500 · due the 14th · check-in Monday

examples.t: Dilnoza, I’d like you to own this quarter’s customer survey.
examples.uz: Dilnoza, bu chorakdagi mijozlar so‘rovnomasini sizga topshirmoqchiman.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob: „Dilnoza, I would like you to own this quarter’s customer survey. The results will shape next year’s product plan, so accuracy matters more than speed. You can spend up to five hundred on tools. Could you have it ready by the fourteenth? Let’s check in on Monday to see how it is going.“ Bu yerda „own“ — egasi bo‘lish, „shape“ — shakllantirmoq. „Could you have it ready by“ — muddatni iltimos shaklida aytish usuli, u buyruqdan yumshoqroq, lekin aniq. Sizning javobingizda natija, sabab, vakolat, muddat va tekshiruv bo‘lsa, vazifa a’lo bajarilgan.
scenes.say: A model answer. Dilnoza, I would like you to own this quarter's customer survey. The results will shape next year's product plan, so accuracy matters more than speed. You can spend up to five hundred on tools. Could you have it ready by the fourteenth? Let's check in on Monday.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy javob. Dilnoza, bu chorakdagi mijozlar so‘rovnomasini sizga topshirmoqchiman. Natijalar kelgusi yilgi mahsulot rejasini belgilaydi, shuning uchun aniqlik tezlikdan muhimroq. Vositalar uchun besh yuzgacha sarflashingiz mumkin. O‘n to‘rtinchi kunga tayyor qila olasizmi? Dushanba kuni ahvolni ko‘ramiz.

scenes.title: Maqsad va kutilmalar
board: SMART: specific · measurable · achievable · relevant · time-bound
By the end of June we will cut response time to 4 hours.
What I expect from you is…

examples.t: By the end of June, we will cut average response time from nine hours to four.
examples.uz: Iyun oxirigacha o‘rtacha javob vaqtini to‘qqiz soatdan to‘rt soatgacha qisqartiramiz.

examples.t: What I expect from each of you is a weekly update by noon on Fridays.
examples.uz: Har biringizdan kutganim — juma kuni tush vaqtigacha haftalik hisobot.

examples.t: Success will look like fewer than five complaints a month.
examples.uz: Muvaffaqiyat oyiga beshtadan kam shikoyat ko‘rinishida bo‘ladi.

scenes.say_native: Yaxshi maqsad „SMART“ bo‘ladi: aniq, o‘lchanadigan, erishish mumkin, ahamiyatli va muddatli. „We will cut response time from nine hours to four by the end of June“ — mana shu aniq maqsad. Faqat „javobni tezlashtiramiz“ desangiz, hech kim nimaga erishilganini bilmaydi. Kutilmalarni ham ochiq ayting: „What I expect from each of you is a weekly update“. Muvaffaqiyat qanday ko‘rinishini ham tasvirlang: „Success will look like fewer than five complaints a month“. Muhim til qoidasi: raqamli maqsadlarda „from … to …“ va „by + sana“ ishlatiladi. O‘zbek tilidagi „tezroq ishlaymiz“ kabi umumiy gap ingliz muhitida maqsad hisoblanmaydi.
scenes.say: A good goal is SMART: specific, measurable, achievable, relevant and time-bound. By the end of June, we will cut average response time from nine hours to four. Also state your expectations openly. What I expect from each of you is a weekly update by noon on Fridays. And describe success: fewer than five complaints a month.
scenes.say_uz: Yaxshi maqsad SMART bo‘ladi: aniq, o‘lchanadigan, erishsa bo‘ladigan, ahamiyatli va muddatli. Iyun oxirigacha o‘rtacha javob vaqtini to‘qqiz soatdan to‘rtga tushiramiz. Kutilmalarni ham ochiq ayting va muvaffaqiyat qanday ko‘rinishini tasvirlang.

scenes.title: Xato: noaniq maqsad
board: ✗ We need to improve quality.
✓ We will reduce defects by 20% by September.
✗ I want it ASAP.
✓ I need it by 3 p.m. on Wednesday.

examples.t: We will reduce product defects by twenty per cent by September.
examples.uz: Sentyabrgacha mahsulot nuqsonlarini yigirma foizga kamaytiramiz.

examples.t: I need the draft by three o’clock on Wednesday, not as soon as possible.
examples.uz: Qoralama chorshanba kuni soat uchgacha kerak, imkon qadar tezroq emas.

scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato — noaniq so‘zlar. „We need to improve quality“ qanday sifat va qachongacha? „ASAP“ esa har kishi uchun boshqacha ma’no beradi: biriga bir soat, ikkinchisiga bir hafta. Buning o‘rniga aniq vaqt ayting: „I need it by three o’clock on Wednesday“. Maqsadda foiz va oy bo‘lsin: „reduce defects by twenty per cent by September“. Yana bir nozik joy: „improve“ fe’lidan keyin nima o‘lchanishini aytmasangiz, jamoa har xil tushunadi. Ish uslubi yaxshi bo‘lsa-da, noaniq kutilma ko‘p mojaroning boshlanishi bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: The most common problem is vague language. We need to improve quality: how much, and by when? As soon as possible means one hour to one person and one week to another. Say instead: we will reduce defects by twenty per cent by September, and I need the draft by three o'clock on Wednesday.
scenes.say_uz: Eng ko‘p uchraydigan muammo — noaniq til. Sifatni yaxshilash kerak: qancha va qachongacha? Imkon qadar tezroq har kimga har xil ma’no beradi. Buning o‘rniga ayting: sentyabrgacha nuqsonlarni yigirma foizga kamaytiramiz, qoralama chorshanba kuni soat uchgacha kerak.

scenes.title: Mashq: noaniq gapni aniqlang
board: 1) We should be faster with invoices.
2) Please send the report soon.
3) Let’s improve customer satisfaction.
scenes.say_native: Uchta noaniq gapni aniq maqsad yoki kutilmaga aylantiring. Birinchi: hisob-fakturalarda tezroq bo‘lishimiz kerak. Ikkinchi: hisobotni yaqinda yuboring. Uchinchi: mijozlar mamnunligini yaxshilaylik. Har birida raqam va muddat bo‘lsin. Javoblaringizni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Turn three vague sentences into clear goals. One: we should be faster with invoices. Two: please send the report soon. Three: let's improve customer satisfaction. Add a number or a deadline to each one.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta noaniq gapni aniq maqsadga aylantiring. Birinchi: hisob-fakturalarda tezroq bo‘laylik. Ikkinchi: hisobotni yaqinda yuboring. Uchinchi: mijozlar mamnunligini yaxshilaylik. Har biriga raqam yoki muddat qo‘shing.

scenes.title: Javoblar: aniq maqsadlar
board: 1) We will send every invoice within two working days.
2) Please send the report by Friday at noon.
3) Raise the satisfaction score from 72 to 80 by December.

examples.t: We will send every invoice within two working days of delivery.
examples.uz: Har bir hisob-fakturani yetkazib berishdan keyin ikki ish kuni ichida yuboramiz.

examples.t: Please send the report by noon on Friday.
examples.uz: Iltimos, hisobotni juma kuni tushgacha yuboring.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi gap: „We will send every invoice within two working days of delivery.“ „Within“ — ichida, muddat chegarasi. Ikkinchisi: „Please send the report by noon on Friday.“ „By“ — shu vaqtgacha. Uchinchisi: „We will raise the satisfaction score from seventy-two to eighty by December.“ Bu yerda „raise … from … to …“ o‘lchanadigan o‘zgarishni ko‘rsatadi. „Within“ va „by“ farqiga e’tibor bering: „within two days“ — hozirdan boshlab hisoblangan davr, „by Friday“ — aniq tugash nuqtasi. Sizning javoblaringizda raqam va muddat bo‘lsa, topshiriq bajarilgan.
scenes.say: One: we will send every invoice within two working days of delivery. Two: please send the report by noon on Friday. Three: we will raise the satisfaction score from seventy-two to eighty by December. Notice that within gives a period, while by gives a deadline point.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: har bir hisob-fakturani yetkazishdan keyin ikki ish kuni ichida yuboramiz. Ikki: hisobotni juma kuni tushgacha yuboring. Uch: mamnunlik ballini dekabrgacha yetmish ikkidan sakson gacha ko‘taramiz. Within davrni, by esa tugash nuqtasini bildiradi.

scenes.title: Rag‘batlantirish va e’tirof
board: Specific + impact + personal thanks
Your analysis saved us two weeks.
I want to recognise Aziz for…
Link work to purpose

examples.t: Your analysis of the churn data saved us two weeks of guesswork.
examples.uz: Mijozlar ketishi bo‘yicha tahlilingiz bizni ikki haftalik taxmindan qutqardi.

examples.t: I want to recognise Aziz for staying late to fix the release.
examples.uz: Aziz relizni tuzatish uchun kech qolgani uchun uni alohida e’tirof etmoqchiman.

examples.t: This project means that thousands of families get their orders on time.
examples.uz: Bu loyiha minglab oilalar buyurtmasini o‘z vaqtida olishini anglatadi.

scenes.say_native: Rag‘bat uchta qismdan iborat: aniq ish, uning ta’siri va shaxsiy minnatdorchilik. „Good job“ juda kuchsiz. Aniqrog‘i: „Your analysis of the churn data saved us two weeks of guesswork.“ Ta’sir raqam bilan bo‘lsa yanada yaxshi. Ommaviy e’tirofda ism ayting: „I want to recognise Aziz for staying late to fix the release“. Yana bir kuchli usul — ishni maqsadga bog‘lash: „Thousands of families get their orders on time“. Odam o‘z ishining ma’nosini ko‘rsa, rag‘bati ortadi. O‘zbek madaniyatida maqtovni ba’zan kamtarlik uchun aytmaymiz, lekin inglizcha ish muhitida aniq tan olish normal va kutiladi.
scenes.say: Recognition has three parts: the specific work, its impact and personal thanks. Good job is weak. Say: your analysis of the churn data saved us two weeks of guesswork. In public, name the person: I want to recognise Aziz for staying late to fix the release. And connect work to purpose: thousands of families get their orders on time.
scenes.say_uz: E’tirof uch qismdan iborat: aniq ish, uning ta’siri va shaxsiy minnatdorchilik. Good job kuchsiz. Ayting: mijozlar ketishi tahlilingiz bizni ikki haftalik taxmindan qutqardi. Ommaviy ravishda ism ayting va ishni maqsadga bog‘lang.

scenes.title: Xato: bo‘sh va adolatsiz maqtov
board: ✗ Great job, everyone. (hamma uchun bir xil)
✓ Sara, your demo won the client.
✗ Thanks, that was your job anyway.

examples.t: Sara, your clear demo is what won us the client.
examples.uz: Sara, mijozni yutib olishimizga aniq demoingiz sabab bo‘ldi.

examples.t: Thank you for taking this on while we were short-staffed.
examples.uz: Xodim yetishmayotgan paytda buni zimmangizga olganingiz uchun rahmat.

scenes.say_native: Maqtovdagi uchta xatoga e’tibor bering. Birinchisi — hamma uchun bir xil gap: „Great job, everyone“. Bunda hech kim o‘zini tan olingan his qilmaydi. Ikkinchisi — kamsituvchi minnatdorchilik: „that was your job anyway“, ya’ni baribir sizning ishingiz edi. Bu motivatsiyani o‘ldiradi. Uchinchisi — kech maqtash: yutuqdan keyin bir oy o‘tib aytilgan so‘z kuchsiz. To‘g‘ri variant: „Sara, your clear demo is what won us the client“. Ism, ish va natija bor. Qiyin sharoitda ishlaganlarga alohida rahmat ayting: „while we were short-staffed“.
scenes.say: Three things spoil praise. First, the same sentence for everyone: great job, everyone. Second, thanks with a sting: that was your job anyway. Third, praise that arrives a month late. Say instead: Sara, your clear demo is what won us the client. Thank you for taking this on while we were short-staffed.
scenes.say_uz: Maqtovni uch narsa buzadi: hamma uchun bir xil gap, nish bilan aytilgan rahmat va bir oy kechikkan maqtov. Buning o‘rniga: Sara, mijozni yutishimizga aniq demoingiz sabab bo‘ldi. Xodim yetishmagan paytda buni zimmangizga olganingiz uchun rahmat.

scenes.title: Mashq: e’tirof ayting
board: Marat rewrote the onboarding guide over a weekend.
New hires now start in 3 days, not 7.
Recognise him in front of the team.
scenes.say_native: Marat dam olish kunlari kirish qo‘llanmasini qayta yozdi. Natijada yangi xodimlar yetti kun emas, uch kunda ishga kirishmoqda. Jamoa oldida uni e’tirof eting. Aniq ish, ta’sir va minnatdorchilikni ayting. Javobingizni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Marat rewrote the onboarding guide over a weekend. New hires now start work in three days instead of seven. Recognise him in front of the team. Mention the specific work, the impact and your thanks.
scenes.say_uz: Marat dam olish kunlari kirish qo‘llanmasini qayta yozdi. Yangi xodimlar endi yetti kun o‘rniga uch kunda ishga kirishadi. Uni jamoa oldida e’tirof eting: aniq ish, ta’sir va minnatdorchilik.

scenes.title: Javob: e’tirof namunasi
board: Marat rewrote the guide over a weekend.
New hires now start in three days.
Thank you, Marat.

examples.t: Marat gave up a weekend to rewrite our onboarding guide.
examples.uz: Marat dam olishini qurbon qilib, qabul qo‘llanmamizni qayta yozdi.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob: „I would like to recognise Marat. He gave up a weekend to rewrite our onboarding guide, and the result is clear: new hires now start working in three days instead of seven. That saves every team time in their first week. Marat, thank you.“ „Give up a weekend“ — dam olish kunini qurbon qilmoq. „Instead of“ — o‘rniga. Javob ism bilan boshlanadi, ish va ta’sirni aytadi, minnatdorchilik bilan tugaydi. Agar siz „Marat, great job“ degan bo‘lsangiz, to‘g‘ri yo‘nalishda, lekin hali aniqlik yetmaydi.
scenes.say: A model answer. I would like to recognise Marat. He gave up a weekend to rewrite our onboarding guide, and the result is clear: new hires now start working in three days instead of seven. That saves every team time in their first week. Marat, thank you.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy javob. Maratni e’tirof etmoqchiman. U dam olish kunini qurbon qilib, kirish qo‘llanmamizni qayta yozdi va natija aniq: yangi xodimlar yetti kun o‘rniga uch kunda ishga kirishadi. Bu har bir jamoaning birinchi haftadagi vaqtini tejaydi. Marat, rahmat.

scenes.title: Yakka uchrashuvlar
board: Their agenda first, yours second
How are you finding the workload?
What’s getting in your way?
Let me make sure I’ve captured the actions.

examples.t: How are you finding the workload at the moment?
examples.uz: Hozirgi ish yuklamasi sizga qanday tuyulyapti?

examples.t: What is getting in your way, and how can I help?
examples.uz: Sizga nima xalaqit beryapti va qanday yordam bera olaman?

examples.t: Where would you like to be in two years?
examples.uz: Ikki yildan keyin o‘zingizni qayerda ko‘rishni xohlaysiz?

scenes.say_native: One-to-one — rahbar va xodim o‘rtasidagi muntazam yakka uchrashuv. Asosiy qoida: avval xodim kun tartibi, keyin sizniki. Ochiq savollar bering: „How are you finding the workload?“ — „find“ bu yerda „his qilmoq, baholamoq“ ma’nosida. Qiyinchilikni aniqlang: „What is getting in your way?“ — sizga nima xalaqit beryapti. Kelajak haqida so‘rang: „Where would you like to be in two years?“ Uchrashuv oxirida kelishuvlarni takrorlang: „Let me make sure I’ve captured the actions“. Bu uchrashuv hisobot emas, ishonch qurish vaqti, shuning uchun siz kamroq gapirib ko‘proq tinglang.
scenes.say: A one-to-one is a regular private meeting with each team member. Their agenda comes first, yours second. Ask open questions: how are you finding the workload at the moment? What is getting in your way, and how can I help? Where would you like to be in two years? At the end, confirm the actions.
scenes.say_uz: One-to-one — har bir jamoa a’zosi bilan muntazam yakka uchrashuv. Avval uning kun tartibi, keyin sizniki. Ochiq savollar bering: ish yuklamasi qanday? Sizga nima xalaqit beryapti? Ikki yildan keyin qayerda bo‘lishni xohlaysiz? Oxirida kelishuvlarni tasdiqlang.

scenes.title: Xato: uchrashuvni bekor qilish va so‘roq
board: ✗ Why haven’t you finished yet? (so‘roq)
✓ What would help you move this forward?
✗ Cancelling the one-to-one again
✓ Let’s reschedule for tomorrow.

examples.t: What would help you move this forward?
examples.uz: Buni oldinga siljitishga nima yordam beradi?

examples.t: I have to move today’s slot, so can we reschedule for tomorrow morning?
examples.uz: Bugungi vaqtni surishim kerak, ertaga ertalabga ko‘chirsak bo‘ladimi?

scenes.say_native: One-to-one’dagi eng katta xato — uni statusni so‘roq qilishga aylantirish: „Why haven’t you finished yet?“ Bunday savol odamni himoyaga o‘tkazadi. Yaxshisi: „What would help you move this forward?“ Ikkinchi xato — uchrashuvni qayta-qayta bekor qilish. Bu xodimga „siz muhim emassiz“ degan xabar beradi. Zarur bo‘lsa, ko‘chiring, lekin darhol yangi vaqt ayting: „Can we reschedule for tomorrow morning?“ Uchinchi xato — telefonga qarab o‘tirish. Faqat suhbatdoshga e’tibor bering. O‘zbekcha „hisobot ber“ uslubi bu yerda ishlamaydi: maqsad nazorat emas, qo‘llab-quvvatlash.
scenes.say: The biggest mistake in a one-to-one is turning it into an interrogation about status: why haven't you finished yet? That puts people on the defensive. Ask instead: what would help you move this forward? Do not cancel repeatedly either. If you must, reschedule at once: can we move it to tomorrow morning?
scenes.say_uz: One-to-one’dagi eng katta xato — uni holat bo‘yicha so‘roqqa aylantirish. Bu odamni himoyaga o‘tkazadi. Buning o‘rniga so‘rang: buni oldinga siljitishga nima yordam beradi? Qayta-qayta bekor qilmang, kerak bo‘lsa darhol ertaga ertalabga ko‘chiring.

scenes.title: Mashq: savollarni qayta yozing
board: 1) Why are you so slow on this?
2) Are you unhappy here?
3) Did you read my email?
scenes.say_native: Uchta qattiq savolni yumshoq, ochiq savolga aylantiring. Birinchi: nega bu ishda shunchalik sustsiz? Ikkinchi: bu yerda xafamisiz? Uchinchi: mening xatimni o‘qidingizmi? Har birini yakka uchrashuvga mos qilib ayting. Javobingizni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Rewrite three harsh questions as open, supportive ones for a one-to-one. One: why are you so slow on this? Two: are you unhappy here? Three: did you read my email?
scenes.say_uz: Uchta qattiq savolni ochiq va qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi savolga aylantiring. Bir: bu ishda nega shunchalik sustsiz? Ikki: bu yerda xafamisiz? Uch: xatimni o‘qidingizmi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: ochiq savollar
board: 1) How is the task going, and what is slowing you down?
2) How are you feeling about your role at the moment?
3) Was there anything unclear in my email?

examples.t: How is the task going, and what is slowing you down?
examples.uz: Ish qanday ketyapti va nima sizni sekinlashtiryapti?

examples.t: How are you feeling about your role at the moment?
examples.uz: Hozir o‘z lavozimingiz haqida o‘zingizni qanday his qilyapsiz?

scenes.say_native: Birinchi: „How is the task going, and what is slowing you down?“ Bu „sustsiz“ ayblovi o‘rniga sababni so‘raydi. Ikkinchi: „How are you feeling about your role at the moment?“ Ha-yo‘q savol o‘rniga ochiq savol, shuning uchun odam batafsil javob beradi. Uchinchi: „Was there anything unclear in my email?“ Bu javobgarlikni o‘zingizga ham oladi: ehtimol, xat tushunarsiz bo‘lgan. „Slow down“ — sekinlashmoq, „slowing you down“ — sizni sekinlashtiryapti. Sizning savollaringiz „how“ yoki „what“ bilan boshlansa, to‘g‘ri yo‘ldasiz.
scenes.say: One: how is the task going, and what is slowing you down? Two: how are you feeling about your role at the moment? Three: was there anything unclear in my email? Open questions starting with how or what invite fuller answers than yes or no questions.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: ish qanday ketyapti va nima sizni sekinlashtiryapti? Ikki: hozir o‘z lavozimingiz haqida o‘zingizni qanday his qilyapsiz? Uch: xatimda tushunarsiz joy bormidi? How yoki what bilan boshlanuvchi ochiq savollar to‘liqroq javob beradi.

scenes.title: Dialog: yakka uchrashuv
board: Manager: Elena · Team member: Timur
Listen: what is Timur’s main problem?
What does Elena offer?
scenes.say_native: Endi haqiqiy uchrashuvni tinglang. Menejer Elena Timur bilan yakka suhbatlashmoqda. Quyidagilarga e’tibor bering: Timurning asosiy muammosi nima va Elena qanday yordam taklif qiladi. Dialog sekin va aniq aytiladi, birinchi tinglashda umumiy ma’noni tushunishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: Elena: Timur, thanks for making time. How are you finding the new client account? Timur: Honestly, it is more than I can handle. I am covering two projects, and the reports keep piling up. Elena: That sounds exhausting. What is getting in your way most? Timur: The weekly reports. They take a full day. Elena: Then let me move the reports to Hana for a month, and we will review in four weeks.
scenes.say_uz: Elena: Timur, vaqt ajratganingiz uchun rahmat. Yangi mijoz hisobi qanday ketyapti? Timur: Ochig‘i, bu men eplay oladigandan ko‘p. Ikkita loyihani yuritaman va hisobotlar to‘planib boryapti. Elena: Bu charchatuvchi eshitilyapti. Sizga eng ko‘p nima xalaqit beryapti? Timur: Haftalik hisobotlar. Ular butun kunni oladi. Elena: Unda hisobotlarni bir oyga Hanaga o‘tkazaman, to‘rt haftadan keyin ko‘rib chiqamiz.

scenes.title: Mashq: dialogni tushunish
board: 1) What is Timur’s problem?
2) Which question does Elena use to find the cause?
3) What is the agreed solution and when is the review?
scenes.say_native: Dialog bo‘yicha uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: Timurning muammosi nima? Ikkinchi: Elena sababni topish uchun qaysi savolni ishlatdi? Uchinchi: qanday yechim kelishildi va qachon qayta ko‘riladi? Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Answer three questions about the dialogue. What is Timur's problem? Which question does Elena use to find the cause? What solution is agreed, and when will it be reviewed?
scenes.say_uz: Dialog bo‘yicha uchta savolga javob bering. Timurning muammosi nima? Elena sababni topish uchun qaysi savolni beradi? Qanday yechim kelishiladi va qachon qayta ko‘riladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: dialog
board: 1) Too much work: two projects + weekly reports
2) What is getting in your way most?
3) Hana takes the reports for a month; review in four weeks

examples.t: Let me move the reports to Hana for a month.
examples.uz: Hisobotlarni bir oyga Hanaga o‘tkazaman.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi: Timurda ish ko‘p, u ikkita loyiha yuritadi va haftalik hisobotlar butun kunini oladi. Ikkinchi: Elena „What is getting in your way most?“ deb so‘radi. U avval hissiyotni tan oldi — „That sounds exhausting“ — keyin sababni so‘radi. Uchinchi: hisobotlar bir oyga Hanaga o‘tadi va to‘rt haftadan keyin ko‘rib chiqiladi. E’tibor bering: Elena maslahat o‘rniga aniq harakat taklif qildi. „Pile up“ — to‘planib qolmoq. „Honestly“ — ochig‘i, samimiy gap oldidan aytiladi. Yaxshi rahbar muammoni eshitadi va vaqtinchalik bo‘lsa ham, aniq yechim beradi.
scenes.say: One: Timur has too much work, two projects plus weekly reports. Two: Elena asks, what is getting in your way most? She first acknowledges the feeling, that sounds exhausting. Three: Hana takes the reports for a month, with a review in four weeks. Elena offers a concrete action, not just advice.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Timurda ish ko‘p, ikkita loyiha va haftalik hisobotlar. Ikki: Elena so‘raydi, eng ko‘p nima xalaqit beryapti? Avval hissiyotni tan oladi. Uch: hisobotlarni bir oyga Hana oladi, to‘rt haftadan keyin ko‘rib chiqiladi. Elena maslahat emas, aniq harakat taklif qiladi.

scenes.title: Dialog: inqirozda topshirish
board: Server failure · launch Friday
Listen: who gets which task?
What authority does Karim have?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog — bosim ostida topshirish. Jumada mahsulot ishga tushadi, lekin server ishdan chiqdi. Rahbar Olivia vazifalarni taqsimlaydi. Tinglang: kimga qaysi vazifa beriladi va Karimda qanday vakolat bor.
scenes.say: Olivia: We have a server problem and the launch is on Friday. Karim, I need you to lead the fix. You can bring in anyone from the platform team. Nina, please take the customer updates, and send one message by four o'clock. Karim: Understood. Do I have the authority to pay for extra hosting? Olivia: Yes, up to five thousand. Update me at noon tomorrow.
scenes.say_uz: Olivia: Serverda muammo bor, ishga tushirish esa juma kuni. Karim, tuzatishga siz rahbarlik qilishingiz kerak. Platforma jamoasidan istalgan odamni jalb qila olasiz. Nina, iltimos, mijozlarga xabar berishni oling va soat to‘rtgacha bitta xabar yuboring. Karim: Tushundim. Qo‘shimcha hosting uchun to‘lash vakolati menda bormi? Olivia: Ha, besh minggacha. Ertaga tushda menga ma’lumot bering.

scenes.title: Mashq: dialogni tahlil qiling
board: 1) Who leads the fix, and who handles customers?
2) What is Karim’s spending limit?
3) When must Nina send her message?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: kim tuzatishga rahbarlik qiladi va kim mijozlar bilan ishlaydi? Ikkinchi: Karimning sarflash chegarasi qancha? Uchinchi: Nina xabarni qachongacha yuborishi kerak? Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Answer three questions. Who leads the fix, and who handles the customers? What is Karim's spending limit? By when must Nina send her message?
scenes.say_uz: Uchta savolga javob bering. Tuzatishga kim rahbarlik qiladi va mijozlar bilan kim ishlaydi? Karimning sarflash chegarasi qancha? Nina xabarni qachongacha yuborishi kerak?

scenes.title: Javoblar: inqiroz dialogi
board: 1) Karim leads the fix; Nina handles customers
3) By four o’clock

examples.t: Karim, I need you to lead the fix.
examples.uz: Karim, tuzatishga rahbarlik qilishingiz kerak.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi: Karim tuzatishni boshqaradi, Nina mijozlarga xabar beradi. Ikkinchi: Karim besh ming funtgacha sarflashi mumkin. Uchinchi: Nina soat to‘rtgacha xabar yuborishi kerak. Qarang, Olivia qisqa jumlalar ishlatdi: „I need you to lead the fix“. Bosim ostida iltimos shakli o‘rniga to‘g‘ri, lekin hurmatli talab yaxshiroq. „Bring in“ — jalb qilmoq. „Update me“ — menga yangiliklarni aytib turing. Karim esa aniq savol berdi: vakolat bormi? Bu yaxshi odat: noaniqlikni darhol so‘rang. Inqirozda ham besh qismli topshiriq ishlaydi, faqat tezroq aytiladi.
scenes.say: One: Karim leads the fix and Nina handles customers. Two: up to five thousand pounds. Three: by four o'clock. Notice Olivia's short, direct sentences: I need you to lead the fix. Under pressure, a direct but respectful request works better than a long, polite one. And Karim asks about his authority straight away, which is a good habit.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Karim tuzatishni boshqaradi, Nina mijozlar bilan ishlaydi. Ikki: besh ming funtgacha. Uch: soat to‘rtgacha. Oliviyaning qisqa, to‘g‘ri gaplariga e’tibor bering. Bosim ostida to‘g‘ri, lekin hurmatli talab uzun muloyim gapdan yaxshiroq. Karim vakolatini darhol so‘raydi, bu yaxshi odat.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: urg‘u va yumshoq ohang
board: Stress the key word: I need it BY Friday.
could you → /kʊdʒə/ (weak, linked)
Falling tone: firm · rising tone: invitation

examples.t: I need the report by Friday, not next week.
examples.uz: Hisobot juma kuni kerak, kelasi hafta emas.

examples.t: Could you take a look at this for me?
examples.uz: Menga buni ko‘rib chiqa olasizmi?

scenes.say_native: Liderga ovoz ham tilning bir qismi. Birinchi qoida: asosiy so‘zga urg‘u bering. „I need it BY Friday“ — bu yerda muddat muhim. Ikkinchi qoida: yordamchi so‘zlar kuchsiz aytiladi. „Could you“ tez nutqda taxminan „kudja“ kabi eshitiladi, chunki „could“ zaif shaklda va „you“ bilan qo‘shilib ketadi. Uchinchi: ohang. Pasayuvchi ohang qat’iylik beradi, ko‘tariluvchi ohang esa taklif yoki so‘rovdek eshitiladi. Topshiriqda pasayuvchi, fikr so‘rashda ko‘tariluvchi ohang ishlating. O‘zbek nutqida ham urg‘u so‘z oxirida bo‘ladi, inglizchada esa ma’noga qarab o‘zgaradi, shuning uchun mashq qiling.
scenes.say: A leader's voice is part of the message. Stress the key word: I need it by Friday. Helper words are weak. In fast speech, could you sounds like kudja, because the two words link. Use a falling tone to sound firm, and a rising tone to invite opinions: could you take a look at this for me?
scenes.say_uz: Liderning ovozi xabarning bir qismi. Asosiy so‘zga urg‘u bering. Yordamchi so‘zlar kuchsiz aytiladi, tez nutqda could you taxminan kudja kabi eshitiladi. Qat’iylik uchun pasayuvchi, fikrga taklif uchun ko‘tariluvchi ohangdan foydalaning.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: boshlang‘ich nutq
board: Kickoff speech, 40 seconds
1 purpose · 2 goal with number · 3 roles · 4 thanks
New app launch in 12 weeks
scenes.say_native: Endi bugungi hamma narsani birlashtiring. Yangi ilovani o‘n ikki haftada chiqarish uchun jamoaga qirq soniyalik boshlang‘ich nutq ayting. Maqsad, raqamli natija, rollar va minnatdorchilik bo‘lsin. Aniq muddat ham qo‘shing. Nutqingizni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Give a forty-second kickoff speech to your team. You will launch a new app in twelve weeks. Include the purpose, a numerical goal, who does what, and a word of thanks. Add one clear deadline.
scenes.say_uz: Jamoaga qirq soniyalik boshlang‘ich nutq ayting. Yangi ilovani o‘n ikki haftada chiqarasiz. Maqsad, raqamli natija, kim nima qilishi va minnatdorchilik bo‘lsin. Bitta aniq muddat qo‘shing.

scenes.title: Javob: nutq namunasi
board: Purpose → goal → roles → thanks
Twelve weeks · 10,000 users · beta in week 8
Let’s build something we are proud of.

examples.t: In twelve weeks, we will put a new app in the hands of ten thousand users.
examples.uz: O‘n ikki haftada yangi ilovani o‘n ming foydalanuvchi qo‘liga yetkazamiz.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy nutq: „Team, in twelve weeks we will put a new app in the hands of ten thousand users, and it will make life easier for our clients. Anna owns design, Bobur owns the build, and Lola owns testing. The beta goes out in week eight. I trust you, and I am here to remove blockers. Let’s build something we are proud of.“ Tuzilishga qarang: maqsad, raqam, rollar, muddat va ishonch bildirish. „Remove blockers“ — to‘siqlarni olib tashlamoq. „Put in the hands of“ — kimningdir qo‘liga yetkazmoq. Sizning nutqingizda shu to‘rt qism bo‘lsa, yaxshi.
scenes.say: A model speech. Team, in twelve weeks we will put a new app in the hands of ten thousand users. Anna owns design, Bobur owns the build and Lola owns testing. The beta goes out in week eight. I trust you, and my job is to remove blockers. Let's build something we are proud of.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy nutq. Jamoa, o‘n ikki haftada yangi ilovani o‘n ming foydalanuvchi qo‘liga yetkazamiz. Anna dizayn, Bobur ishlab chiqish, Lola sinov uchun javob beradi. Beta sakkizinchi haftada chiqadi. Sizlarga ishonaman, mening vazifam to‘siqlarni olib tashlash. Faxrlanadigan narsa yarataylik.

scenes.title: Takrorlash
board: Delegate: outcome · context · authority · deadline · check-in
Goals: SMART, from … to … by …
Recognise: specific + impact + thanks
One-to-one: open questions, listen, confirm actions
scenes.say_native: Bugun to‘rtta asosiy ko‘nikmani o‘rgandik. Birinchi: topshirishda natija, kontekst, vakolat, muddat va tekshiruv vaqti. Ikkinchi: maqsadlar aniq, raqamli va muddatli bo‘lsin; „within“ davr, „by“ nuqta. Uchinchi: e’tirofda aniq ish, ta’sir va rahmat. To‘rtinchi: yakka uchrashuvda ochiq savollar, tinglash va oxirida kelishuvlarni takrorlash. Talaffuzda asosiy so‘zga urg‘u, qat’iylik uchun pasayuvchi ohang. Bu ko‘nikmalarni ishda keyingi hafta har bir jamoa a’zosiga qo‘llab ko‘ring.
scenes.say: Let's review. When you delegate, give the outcome, context, authority, deadline and check-in. Make goals specific, measurable and time-bound. Recognise people with specific work, impact and thanks. In one-to-ones, ask open questions, listen and confirm actions. Stress key words and use a falling tone when you need to sound firm.
scenes.say_uz: Takrorlaymiz. Topshirganda natija, kontekst, vakolat, muddat va tekshiruvni bering. Maqsadlar aniq, o‘lchanadigan va muddatli bo‘lsin. Odamlarni aniq ish, ta’sir va rahmat bilan e’tirof eting. Yakka uchrashuvda ochiq savol bering, tinglang va kelishuvlarni tasdiqlang.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Homework: team kickoff speech
60–90 seconds · written, then read aloud
Include: purpose, number, roles, deadline, thanks
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa: jamoa uchun boshlang‘ich nutq yozing. Hajmi oltmish-to‘qson soniya bo‘lsin. Unda maqsad, raqamli natija, rollar, muddat va minnatdorchilik bo‘lsin. Avval yozing, keyin baland ovozda o‘qib, yozib oling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: nutqda kamida bitta „by“ yoki „within“ bilan aniq muddat va bitta aniq e’tirof bor. Keyingi darsda media, intervyu va jurnalistika tilini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is to write a team kickoff speech of sixty to ninety seconds. Include a purpose, a number, clear roles, a deadline and a word of thanks. Then read it aloud and record it. See you next time, when we work on media interviews.
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifa: oltmish-to‘qson soniyalik jamoa boshlang‘ich nutqini yozing. Unda maqsad, raqam, aniq rollar, muddat va minnatdorchilik bo‘lsin. Keyin baland ovozda o‘qib yozib oling. Keyingi safar media intervyulari ustida ishlaymiz.

homework_uz: Jamoa uchun oltmish-to‘qson soniyalik boshlang‘ich nutq yozing va ovoz chiqarib yozib oling. Unda maqsad, raqamli natija, rollar, “by” yoki “within” bilan aniq muddat va bitta aniq e’tirof bo‘lsin. Keyingi darsda media, intervyu va jurnalistika tilini o‘rganamiz.

quiz.q: Which sentence is the best delegation?
options: I would like you to own the survey; it shapes our plan. Budget is 500, due the 14th, check-in Monday.
Send me every draft and I will decide.
Maybe you can try something with the survey.
quiz.why_uz: To‘g‘ri variantda natija, sabab, vakolat, muddat va tekshiruv bor.

options: We will cut response time from nine hours to four by the end of June.
quiz.why_uz: SMART maqsadda raqam va muddat bo‘ladi.
“Within” muddat davrini bildiradi: ikki ish kuni ichida.

quiz.q: “I need the draft ___ Wednesday at 3 p.m.”

options: Sara, your demo won us the client.
quiz.why_uz: Ism, aniq ish va natija bor.

options: Controlling every small step of someone’s work
quiz.why_uz: Micromanage — har bir mayda qadamni nazorat qilish.

quiz.q: Which question suits a one-to-one best?
options: What is getting in your way?
quiz.why_uz: Ochiq va qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi savol ishonchni oshiradi.

quiz.q: In a one-to-one, whose agenda comes first?
quiz.why_uz: Avval xodim kun tartibi, keyin rahbarniki.

options: Let’s have a short check-in on Thursday
Let’s start the project on Thursday
quiz.why_uz: Touch base — qisqa aloqa o‘rnatib, ahvolni bilish.

quiz.q: To sound firm, which tone is best at the end of an instruction?
